cues.en: Even if you've never heard of a carbon steel skillet, you've almost certainly eaten food made in one. Restaurant chefs use carbon steel for everything from searing steak to sauteing onions to cooking eggs.
cues.zh: 就算你从没听说过碳钢煎锅，你也几乎肯定吃过用它做的菜。餐厅大厨用碳钢锅做各种菜，从煎牛排到炒洋葱再到煎鸡蛋。

cues.en: French omelet and crepe pans are made of carbon steel, and so are Chinese woks.
cues.zh: 法式煎蛋卷锅和可丽饼锅都是碳钢做的，中式炒锅也是。

cues.en: In European home kitchens,
cues.zh: 在欧洲家庭厨房里，

cues.en: these pans are hugely popular, but somehow they've never really caught on with home cooks in The United States.
cues.zh: 这些锅非常受欢迎，但不知怎么的，它们一直没能真正在美国家庭厨师中流行起来。

cues.en: But these pans have a reputation for being as great at browning as they are for keeping delicate foods from sticking, So we knew it was time to check them out.
cues.zh: 但这些锅的名声是，既能出色地上色，又能防止娇嫩食物粘锅，所以我们觉得是时候测一测它们了。

cues.en: We bought eight carbon steel skillets, all as close as possible to 12 inches, which is our preferred size for a primary skillet. Carbon steel pans are surprisingly inexpensive.
cues.zh: 我们买了八口碳钢煎锅，尺寸都尽量接近12英寸，这是我们主煎锅的首选尺寸。碳钢锅便宜得令人意外。

cues.en: Most of these cost just 40 to $80. But out of curiosity, we also included a 230
cues.zh: 大多数只要40到80美元。但出于好奇，我们还加入了一口230美元的

cues.en: hand forged pan made in Seattle.
cues.zh: 西雅图手工锻造锅。

cues.en: Now, we tried our carbon steel pans with a wide variety of recipes, because they're supposed to be able to do it all. We fried eggs. We made cheese omelettes. We pan seared steak. We even made the traditional French upside down apple dessert called tarte tatin.
cues.zh: 我们用碳钢锅试了各种各样的食谱，因为它们号称什么都能做。我们煎了鸡蛋。做了芝士煎蛋卷。煎了牛排。我们甚至做了传统的法式翻转苹果甜点——塔丁苹果塔。

cues.en: This dessert begins on the stove with caramelizing apples and then moves to the oven to bake up the crust. Then you have to flip out this sticky, delicate dessert.
cues.zh: 这道甜点先在炉灶上把苹果焦糖化，然后移入烤箱烤酥皮。接着你得把这个黏黏的、娇嫩的甜点翻扣出来。

cues.en: Because these pans are made entirely of metal, they have no upper limits on their oven safe temperatures,
cues.zh: 因为这些锅完全由金属制成，所以它们的耐烤箱温度没有上限，

cues.en: so you can use them in the oven any time.
cues.zh: 因此你可以随时把它们放进烤箱用。

cues.en: Along the way, as always, when we're testing skillets, we checked out their shape, their weight, their handle comfort, and how maneuverable they felt for a variety of testers. We washed the pans after every use to let us judge how easy they were to clean and maintain.
cues.zh: 在测试煎锅的过程中，我们一如既往地检查了它们的形状、重量、手柄舒适度，以及在不同测试者手中是否操作灵活。每次使用后我们都清洗锅具，以便评估它们清洁和维护的难易程度。

cues.en: Speaking of maintenance, the very first thing we learned about carbon steel is that, like cast iron, it rusts if the metal is bare. New pans have to be seasoned before you can start cooking.
cues.zh: 说到维护，我们了解到碳钢的第一件事就是：和铸铁一样，如果金属裸露在外就会生锈。新锅必须先开锅才能开始烹饪。

cues.en: Seasoning just means bonding oil to the pan,
cues.zh: 开锅就是把油附着到锅上，

cues.en: which provides a layer of rust protection but also starts the process of making the pan nonstick.
cues.zh: 这层油既能防锈，也开始让锅变得不粘。

cues.en: This probably sounds a little more complicated than it actually was. In fact, two of our eight pans arrived pre seasoned, but the other six needed us to get them started.
cues.zh: 这听起来可能比实际操作要复杂一些。事实上，我们八口锅中有两口到货时已经开过锅，但另外六口需要我们自行开锅。

cues.en: Now, first, you need to scrub off the shipping grease or wax that the manufacturers coat the pans with so they won't rust before you get them home.
cues.zh: 首先，你需要擦掉制造商涂在锅上的运输油脂或蜡，防止锅在你带回家之前生锈。

cues.en: And then we followed each brand's recommendations for seasoning the pans.
cues.zh: 然后我们按照各品牌的建议来开锅。

cues.en: In the end, we found one simple method that our winner used.
cues.zh: 最终，我们找到了一种简单的方法，也是我们获胜产品所采用的。

cues.en: You just cook the peels of two potatoes in a ton of oil and salt. That's actually a third cup of oil and two thirds cups of salt for about eight to ten minutes until they're nice and brown and crispy. And you move the peels around the pan to coat it well.
cues.zh: 你只需用大量油和盐煎两个土豆皮。具体是三分之一杯油和三分之二杯盐，煎大约八到十分钟，直到土豆皮变得金黄酥脆。期间在锅中来回移动土豆皮，让锅面均匀裹上油。

cues.en: And then you throw those peels out.
cues.zh: 然后你把那些果皮扔掉。

cues.en: You wipe out and rinse the pan, you dry it, and you're good to go. The peels seem to help soak up any remaining shipping grease or wax while the hot oil seasons the metal.
cues.zh: 你擦净并冲洗平底锅，然后把它擦干，就可以直接用了。这些果皮似乎有助于吸收任何残留的运输油脂或蜡，同时热油也在对金属进行开锅。

cues.en: Now most of the pans, once we'd season them, were amazingly nonstick after one round of seasoning.
cues.zh: 现在大部分平底锅，一旦我们开过锅，经过一轮处理后就会变得惊人地不粘。

cues.en: We saw fried eggs sliding around like a puck in air hockey,
cues.zh: 我们看到煎蛋像空气曲棍球里的冰球一样四处滑动，

cues.en: omelettes rolling out in perfect golden oblongs,
cues.zh: 煎蛋卷卷成完美的金黄色长方形，

cues.en: zero sticking.
cues.zh: 完全不粘。

cues.en: Tarts popped right out with very few exceptions, looking glossy and intact.
cues.zh: 除了极少数例外，蛋挞轻而易举地就脱模了，看起来光泽且完整。

cues.en: And each time we cooked,
cues.zh: 而且每次我们做饭时，

cues.en: more patina built up as the hot oil polymerized and bonded to the surface of the pans.
cues.zh: 随着热油聚合并结合到锅的表面，会形成更多的油膜。

cues.en: The shiny silver surfaces of the new pans got more brown and blotchy, and that's a good thing. It means your pan is getting seasoned.
cues.zh: 新锅亮闪闪的银色表面变得更加棕色和斑驳，这是件好事。这意味着你的锅正在形成油膜。

cues.en: Over a couple of months of cooking, the pan will keep darkening and getting more nonstick,
cues.zh: 经过几个月的烹饪，平底锅会不断变黑，变得越来越不粘，

cues.en: till it's almost solidly black or dark brown, and that's what you're working towards. As a result, you never want to scrub with an abrasive or use soap on these pans, just like cast iron pans.
cues.zh: 直到它几乎完全变成黑色或深棕色，这正是你努力的方向。因此，你绝不能像对待铸铁锅那样，用研磨剂去刷洗这些锅，也不能用肥皂。

cues.en: Most of the time, we weren't even tempted to scrub because nothing stuck. We could practically just wipe them out with a paper towel after we're cooking.
cues.zh: 大多数时候，我们甚至连刷洗的念头都没有，因为根本不粘。做完饭后，我们基本上用纸巾一擦就行了。

cues.en: Otherwise, hot water, a gentle swish with a soft sponge, rinse, dry well with the towel and the stove's heat, and oil it lightly. That's all you need to do.
cues.zh: 否则的话，用热水，用软海绵轻轻转圈清洗，冲洗干净，用毛巾和炉灶余温彻底烘干，然后薄薄地抹上一层油。这就是你需要做的全部。

cues.en: Now another benefit of carbon steel skillets,
cues.zh: 碳钢煎锅还有另一个好处，

cues.en: searing steaks and browning foods.
cues.zh: 就是煎牛排和把食物煎上色。

cues.en: A smoking hot traditional skillet does a perfectly acceptable job, and a cast iron skillet is brilliant at browning and searing. But we found the carbon steel pans trumped both of them, and we got impressively deep, even browning in the best carbon steel pans, easily on a par with cast iron. Carbon steel pans have another bonus. They're lighter and thinner,
cues.zh: 烧到冒烟的传统煎锅完全够用，铸铁煎锅在煎上色方面非常出色。但我们发现碳钢锅胜过这两者，最好的碳钢锅能煎出令人印象深刻的均匀上色，轻松媲美铸铁。碳钢锅还有一个优点，它们更轻更薄，

cues.en: so they heat up in almost half the time as cast iron, and they're easier to lift and handle. The only drawback we could find was when we made skillet lasagna.
cues.zh: 所以加热时间几乎只有铸铁的一半，而且更容易拿起和操作。我们唯一发现的缺点是做煎锅千层面的时候。

cues.en: The long simmering tomato sauce stripped off our seasoning,
cues.zh: 长时间炖煮的番茄酱把我们的油膜给剥掉了，

cues.en: but we didn't notice any off flavors in the food, and the patina came right back after a couple of rounds of heating and wiping the pan with oil on the stovetop.
cues.zh: 但食物并没有什么异味，而且在灶台上加热并抹油几轮之后，那层油膜很快就回来了。

cues.en: A quick, short use of an acidic ingredient like a tomato based pan sauce had no effect on the seasoning.
cues.zh: 短暂使用番茄基底的锅内酱汁这类酸性食材，对油膜没有影响。

cues.en: Now finally,
cues.zh: 最后，

cues.en: features helped us single out our favorites.
cues.zh: 各种特性帮我们挑出了最喜欢的几款。

cues.en: Some of these pans felt unbalanced or had slightly cramped cooking surfaces.
cues.zh: 有些锅感觉重心不稳，或者烹饪面积略显局促。

cues.en: Other ones had too high sides that made it awkward to get under food with a spatula or so low that liquids kind of threatened to splash out. And several had unusually
cues.zh: 还有些锅的锅壁太高，用锅铲铲到食物底下很别扭，要么就是太低，液体容易溅出来。还有几款有着异常

cues.en: long steeply angled handles. They were a little bit awkward for shorter testers and they barely fit in the oven when we made tarte tatin.
cues.zh: 长且陡斜的锅柄。对个子矮的测试者来说有点别扭，做翻转苹果挞时几乎放不进烤箱。

cues.en: Now at the end of testing, we knew carbon steel skillets had earned a place in our kitchen and we had two top choices.
cues.zh: 经过测试，我们发现碳钢平底锅确实配得上我们厨房的一席之地，并且我们有了两个最佳选择。

cues.en: First, the Matra Bourgette black steel round frying pan. It's just $44.
cues.zh: 首先是 Matra Bourgette 黑色钢制圆煎锅，售价只要 44 美元。

cues.en: This is a simple classic pan that cooks beautifully.
cues.zh: 这是一口简单经典且烹饪效果极佳的锅。

cues.en: It's sturdy, it's easy to handle, smooth, and the inside is rivet free, so it doesn't trap any bits of food.
cues.zh: 它坚固耐用、易于操控、表面光滑，而且内部没有铆钉，不会卡住任何食物残渣。

cues.en: If you have the money, the hand forged pan is a stunner. It comes pre seasoned, and it performed perfectly.
cues.zh: 如果你预算充足，那口手工锻造的锅绝对惊艳。它已经开过锅了，表现堪称完美。

cues.en: It's called the blue skillet ironware 13 inch fry pan for $230.
cues.zh: 它叫 Blue Skillet Ironware 13英寸煎锅，售价 230 美元。
